source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6 + FAQ update Nov 2025

mandatory_declarations.label: Manufacturer / Packer Name & Address
mandatory_declarations.description: Full name and complete postal address of the manufacturer or packer, including PIN code.

mandatory_declarations.label: Net Quantity
mandatory_declarations.description: Net quantity in standard SI units: mass (g/kg), volume (ml/L), or count (Number/N).
mandatory_declarations.note: Must not include the weight of packaging.

mandatory_declarations.label: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
mandatory_declarations.description: MRP inclusive of all taxes, in Indian Rupees. Both 'Rs.' and '₹' are acceptable.

mandatory_declarations.label: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing
mandatory_declarations.description: Month and year of manufacture or packing. Format: MM/YYYY, MM-YYYY, or abbreviated month name.

mandatory_declarations.label: Expiry / Best Before / Use By Date
mandatory_declarations.description: Expiry date, best before date, or use by date. Can be expressed as months from manufacture.

mandatory_declarations.label: Consumer Care Phone / Email
mandatory_declarations.description: Consumer care contact — phone number (toll-free preferred) and/or email address.

mandatory_declarations.label: FSSAI License Number
mandatory_declarations.description: 14-digit FSSAI license number for food and beverage products.

principal_display_panel.description: The PDP is the surface of the package most likely to be displayed to the consumer at the point of sale.

area_formulas.rectangular: one full side (length × width of largest face)
area_formulas.cylindrical: 40% of total lateral surface area (π × diameter × height × 0.4)

minimum_font_heights_mm.note: Font height measured as the height of capital letters on the PDP.

exemptions.description: Packages marked 'NOT FOR RETAIL SALE' supplied to industrial or institutional consumers are exempt from MRP and consumer care requirements.
Packages intended solely for export are exempt from these rules.

mrp_format_rules.note: The phrasing 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes' is required on the label.
